description: Delete a child workspace with everything in it (keywords, mentions, alerts, channels, keys, members). Its remaining balance comes back to your workspace first; a debt it ran up is settled from yours. Cannot be undone.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. A unique value (a UUID) for this call: 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters, no spaces. Calling again with the same key and the same input within 24 hours returns the first result instead of doing it twice.

name: delete_workspace
title: Delete workspace
